1
Aale Nabi pe ye kaisa aaya hay imtehan
Al amaan al amaan
Gustakhon ke hajoom may Zainab thi darmiyan

2
Hairan hoon bazar se kaise guzar gaye
Tat-heer ki pali thi,  bazaar kar samaan
Al amman al amaan

3
Ye soch ke Sajjad ka dil khoon ro parra
Tafseer be rida thi,  naizay pe tha Quran

4
Kaise uthay lash ko mazloom chal diye
Shabbir ki zaeefi,  Akbar sa no jawan

5
Kyun bar bar letay ho tum naam balwa aam may
Mar jaye gi bazar may,  haey aaj meri maa

6
Fakr e Khaleel teri himmat ko hay salam
Phal kahinchna pisar ka,  hota nahi asaan

7
Yasrab se jo Ameer chala tha Ashoor ko
Karbal may woh luta hay,  Risalat ka karwan

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/gustakhon-ke-hujoom-mein-zainab-thi-darmiyan.md'
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---\\n', 2)[2].strip('\\n')
_, metadata, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line[2:] for line in metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
assert roman == original
for edition, digits in [(roman, '1234567'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵۶۷')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip('\\n').split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [block[0] for block in blocks] == list(digits)
    assert [len(block) - 1 for block in blocks] == [3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2]
print('Verified exact Roman wording and 16 matching verses across seven stanzas.')
PY"
